Print_Text_SWH.TenFortyForm_info:
Department of the Treasury - Internal Revenue Service.
U.S. Individual Income Tax Return, for the year Jan. 1 - Dec. 31, 1993.

A completely ordinary, unfilled tax form. Filing Status, Exemptions, Income, Adjustments to Income, and Adjusted Gross Income sections all sit blank, waiting on a taxpayer who was never going to get around to it.
Print_Text_SWH.SpiffoInvite_info:
The lettering is cut from magazine pages, ransom-note style. Underneath it, Spiffo's face looks out from behind a heavy spray of dried blood.

Small print at the bottom, barely legible under the stains:
'NO CANDLES OR FIREWORKS PLEASE.'
Print_Text_SWH.StrangeNewspaper_info:
WEEKLY WORLD NEWS, May 11 1993, 60p.

UFO FIRES ON LOUISVILLE, KY. POLICE CHOPPER!
2 COPS SURVIVE MOST AMAZING ENCOUNTER OF 1993!

A callout box promises 'SHOCKING EYEWITNESS ACCOUNTS!' beside a photo of a police helicopter under fire from a cigar-shaped craft. A smaller clipping reads: 'Police officers report dogfight between UFO and helicopter.'
